said: Signed-in people can now start a topic (picking Bug, Idea or Question) and reply to others. Posts can have bold text, links and code, with a Preview button, and nobody can sneak harmful code into a post.
see: Open it, sign in, press New topic, pick the label Bug, write a few lines with a link and some code, and post it. It shows on the board. Then open it and write a reply.
